Study-level quality-appraisal scores (rubric of Table~13 of the main article; scale 0 = absent, 1 = partial, 2 = full). RD = research design; AC = architectural clarity; VE = validation environment; MS = measurements; BL = baselines; TM = threat model; RP = reproducibility; ST = statistical treatment; LM = limitations. The author-confirmed appraisal supplies nine scores for every study (666 cells), with totals out of 18 and no unscored criteria. Scores qualify interpretation rather than eligibility; the rubric does not provide a validated overall risk-of-bias instrument.
